text:
maya_cs: Hey team — AuroraMed signed the SOW for a Private deployment and want to onboard a custom clinical triage model. They uploaded artifacts + an eval sheet to S3.
lee_engineer: thanks — can you drop the S3 path here and any hard constraints? interested in model size, format, and license.
maya_cs: s3://auroramed-uploads/triage-model-v2.tar.gz. Notes: ~11B params, HF checkpoint (pytorch_model.bin + config.json + tokenizer files). License: Apache-2.0 but tokenizer trained on a third-party dataset they flagged. PHI handling required, want KMS/HSM and token-level audit logs.
devon_researcher: we'll need the eval CSV. Also any customer-defined rejection criteria? e.g., thresholds for false negatives on critical triage.
maya_cs: eval CSV is at s3://auroramed-uploads/aurora_evals.csv. They want extremely low false negatives on high-severity cases and an explicit override flow for low-confidence outputs.
lee_engineer: for Private we can import HF artifacts. Need to know if they want quantized variants or full fp16. Also runtime hooks for audit logging.
maya_cs: customer prefers FP16 initially; open to quantization if it preserves sensitivity. Audit logging mandatory per their compliance team.
deploy-bot: Deploy checklist created: /deploys/auroramed-triage-1726000001 (INFRA-9123).
sarah_csm: heads-up: renewal risk flagged if SLAs aren't met — Aurora expects 99.9% uptime and <300ms p95 on production. They'll reconsider renewal if latency/cost profile is worse than their internal infra.
lee_engineer: initial canary targets: 2k requests/day, p95 < 300ms on Dedicated A100s (or equivalent). We'll run INT8 and 4-bit quant experiments to optimize cost while keeping FNR low.
devon_researcher: safety plan proposal: run three eval suites — PHI hallucination detection, severity misclassification, and prompt-injection attacks. Propose pass thresholds: FNR for high-severity < 3%, hallucination rate < 0.5%.
maya_cs: Customer agreed to those targets pending legal review. They also require key rotation schedule and HSM-backed keys.
lee_engineer: KMS/HSM supported in Private. We'll need the customer's KMS ARN and network peering info. I'll open an infra ticket for peering and IAM.
deploy-bot: Ticket INFRA-9123 — KMS peering & network setup created by lee_engineer.
maya_cs: Added peering requirement to the SOW notes.
sarah_csm: Enablement: need a 1.5hr session (endpoints, metrics, retraining hook). Aurora prefers Thurs 11am PST next week.
maya_cs: Confirmed with customer — Thu 11am PST works. Invite to be sent.
lee_engineer: quick ask — can they share a small set of production prompts? helps us set prefix caching and batching configs.
maya_cs: yes: /prompts/production_prompts.md in the S3 folder. Also included example webhook code for overrides.
devon_researcher: I'll prep the eval harness and run on our staging cluster; aiming to deliver initial safety + perf results by EOD +3.
lee_engineer: if quantization necessary, we'll run accuracy sweep with int8 and nf4, and report token-cost delta.
maya_cs: tagging @rachel_legal for PHI clause review — rachel_legal can you review the SOW in the bucket?
rachel_legal: On it, will review SOW and data processing addendum by EOD tomorrow.
maya_cs: perfect — I'll update Aurora after legal signoff. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
